request: Owner, 9 Nov (guides screenshots): «иконки немного идут не по теме. Там, где DSU, ISEEU, сделай просто иконку, связанную с деньгами. Codice fiscale — больше такую бумажку. И другие сделай не просто везде конвертики, а более такое реальное».
model: gpt_image_2_6 (Higgsfield), quality high, 1k, transparent background, 4:3; two concepts per topic, one kept
promptTemplate: Semi-conceptual object icon, halfway between a premium product photograph and a refined 3D app icon: [concept]. Slightly simplified, idealized forms with softly rounded edges and fewer, cleaner details than a photograph, while keeping real material cues: [materials]. Soft even studio light from the upper left, gentle ambient occlusion, a small soft contact shadow directly under the object. Warm palette of cream, sand, terracotta red, deep sage green and brushed brass. Three-quarter view from slightly above, centred. Fully transparent background with crisp clean silhouette edges: no glow, no halo, no white rim, no backdrop. No text, letters, numbers, logos, emblems, flags, people or hands. (Small icons add: a bold simple silhouette that stays readable at 24 pixels.)
processing: Trimmed, fitted (inside 468×(H−12)) and centred in the exact old 480×H frames, so no layout moves; WebP q84/alpha92 at 480 and 240. Reviewed at full size and on #2A2420 and #FFFDF9: no text, numerals, currency symbols, portraits, emblems, flags or people; the signature is an abstract loop.
